name: get_course_outline
description: Return cached sections and compact activity samples for one unambiguous course. For an assignment or TA, practical, lab, or exam topic, use authorized email > explicit Paideia instructions > current syllabus > materials. Stop on a clear instruction and label the result confirmed, scheduled, or inferred. An ordinary class uses the fast academic-week flow. Includes live-clock academicContext from the curated KIT PUCP calendar registry. Use referenceWeek and explicit section labels before choosing current materials; use referenceDate for a future class. If calendarRegistration.required is true, refresh the registry with get_academic_calendar and report a missing term honestly; use set_academic_calendar only as a temporary local fallback.

forceRefresh.description: Start a metadata refresh when true while returning the last good cache.

referenceDate.description: Optional target class date for material matching; does not replace the current server date.
